verdict.rationale: Stripe's agentic commerce stack is built on openly published protocols. ACP is an Apache-2.0 open specification any business can implement, and MPP's full spec is public at mpp.dev with governance. MPP also ships conformance tooling: `mppx validate` tests discovery, challenge formats, error handling and the full payment flow, and the versioned mppx SDK is on npm. The custom ACS integration documents a reverse API with defined request/response shapes and session statuses. Missing for 10: explicit protocol versioning or a version policy, a machine-readable schema artifact (e.g. JSON Schema or OpenAPI) for ACP/UCP, conformance tooling beyond MPP (none shown for ACP), and independent corroboration — one community comment calls the MPP end-to-end docs sparse.
